observed_relations.evidence: 42,520-ha baseline and 48,330-ha EFFIS comparison refer to the same selected-fire universe in the registered submission benchmark registry case.

claim_requested: The EFFIS whole-year value is stronger robustness evidence for the registered selected-fire comparison.

original_object.construct: burned area for the registered selected-fire set
original_object.event_universe: selected fires used in the high-resolution comparison
original_object.source_identity: High-resolution estimate reported by Vallet et al. (2023)
original_object.version: source version registered in the submission benchmark record

replacement_object.event_universe: broader whole-year event set including events outside the matched selected-fire set
replacement_object.source_identity: EFFIS whole-year value reported by Vallet et al. (2023)
replacement_object.version: source version registered in the submission benchmark record

observed_relations.evidence: The 66,393-ha whole-year value contains a broader event set, including events outside the registered selected-fire universe.
Both values are reported in hectares.

pcae.interpretation: Same-claim support is impossible for this candidate object under the registered selected-fire claim.

licensed_statement: The arithmetic 66,393 / 42,520 = 1.561453 (1.561) describes the supplied whole-year value relative to the selected-fire baseline, but it is not a robustness result for the same selected-fire claim.
prohibited_escalation: Do not describe 1.561 as a stronger robustness effect for the original selected-fire claim.
reason: The claim-defining event universe changed; numerical magnitude cannot compensate for that failed relation.
downstream_consequence: The current candidate cannot be repaired by acquiring a missing evidence role. Use a candidate matched to the registered selected-fire universe or register a different scientific question.
